_comment: Generated by scripts/build_manual_geometry.py from the owner's tools (do not edit). Glyph advances of the 3DS system font (CWDH units; the console draws them at fontSize / 25) with the patched letters' donors, as the manuals build measures them. overhangs: units between a glyph's ink and the end of its advance (assets/font_ink.json). homoglyphs: the active variant of src/homoglyphs.json (default real).
